title: Returning a jacket
instructionsHu: Egy londoni ruhaboltban vettél egy dzsekit, de később kiderült, hogy baj van vele. Vidd vissza, magyarázd el a problémát, és intézd el, hogy kicseréljék, vagy visszakapd a pénzed. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: Yesterday you bought a jacket in a clothes shop in London. When you got back to your hotel, you noticed that the zip was broken and the jacket was a bit too small for you. Today you are taking it back to the shop.
situation.candidateRole: You are a customer who wants to return the jacket.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is the shop assistant.
goals: Explain when you bought the jacket and what is wrong with it.
Say what you would prefer: a bigger size or your money back.
Ask whether they have the jacket in a different colour.
Decide what to do and thank the assistant.
situation.examinerOpening: Good morning. Can I help you?

followUpQuestions: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Have you got the receipt with you?
Would you like to exchange it, or would you prefer a refund?
We've only got the bigger size in green, I'm afraid. Would that be all right?

usefulPhrases.en: I bought this jacket here yesterday.
usefulPhrases.hu: Tegnap vettem itt ezt a dzsekit.

usefulPhrases.en: It's a bit too small for me.
Could I exchange it for a bigger size?
Have you got it in black?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Good morning. I bought this jacket here yesterday afternoon, but when I got back to my hotel, I noticed that the zip was broken. It's also a bit too small for me.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Have you got the receipt with you?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Thank you. Would you like to exchange it, or would you prefer a refund?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd prefer a bigger size, because I really like the style and it's very warm. Have you got it in a large?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: We've only got the bigger size in green, I'm afraid. Would that be all right?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hmm, I'm not sure. Have you got it in any other colours, for example dark blue?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Not in a large, I'm sorry. Only green. Or I can give you your money back.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Could I try on the green one first?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Of course. The changing rooms are over there.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It fits perfectly, and the colour is actually quite nice. I'll take the green one. Thank you for being so helpful!

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó elmondja, mikor vette a dzsekit és mi a baj vele, megmondja, hogy nagyobb méretet szeretne, rákérdez más színekre, végül mérlegel, dönt és megköszöni a segítséget – minden szempont teljesül, sorrendben.
Szókincs: a reklamáció és a vásárlás szavai pontosak (the zip was broken, receipt, exchange, refund, try on, it fits perfectly).
Nyelvhelyesség: a múltbeli eseményeket egyszerű múlt írja le (bought, got back, noticed, was broken), a kívánságot az „I'd prefer …”, a döntést az „I'll take …” fejezi ki helyesen.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I noticed that the zip was broken”, „I'd prefer a bigger size”, „Could I try on the green one first?”, „Thank you for being so helpful!”.
